title: Two Sum
description: Find two numbers that add up to a target using hash map optimization.

data.text: Given an array `nums` and target, return indices of two numbers that add up to target.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)

data.text: Store values seen so far. Check complement in O(1).

data.title: Hash Map O(n)

data.text: Sort a copy of the array along with original indices, then use left/right pointers to close in on the target. O(n log n) time, O(n) space for the sorted copy.

data.title: Two-Pointer O(n log n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(n) for the map. This is the optimal interview solution.

cards.title: Sorted Two-Pointer
cards.description: Sort then scan from both ends
cons: O(n) extra space for sorted copy
